 ADVERTISEMENT
 CAT admit card 2026 to be released this week at iimcat.ac.in; check exam date and pattern
 CAT 2026 admit cards are expected this week ahead of the November 29 exam. Candidates can check the exam pattern, download steps and result details here.
 Curated by Yash Wardhan Singh 
 Image: Official website 
 Nov 02, 2026
 Share
 The Indian Institutes of Management (IIMs) are expected to make the CAT Admit Card 2026 available this week. Students appearing for the Common Admission Test (CAT) will be able to download their hall tickets from the official website, iimcat.ac.in. 
 CAT 2026: Exam date and pattern 
 The CAT 2026 examination is scheduled for November 29, 2026. The question paper will have 68 questions divided into three sections: 
 Section 1: Verbal Ability and Reading Comprehension (VARC) 
 Section 2: Data Interpretation and Logical Reasoning (DILR) 
 Section 3: Quantitative Ability (QA) 
 Candidates will get a total of two hours to complete the examination. Each section will have a fixed time limit of 40 minutes. Once candidates start answering a section, they cannot move to another section until the allotted time is over. 
 For every correct answer, candidates will receive three marks. One mark will be deducted for each wrong answer. 
 Students can also take a mock test available on the CAT website to understand the exam format and question pattern before the actual examination. 
 The entrance test will take place at examination centres in around 170 cities across the country. 
 CAT Admit Card 2026: Steps to download 
 Candidates can get their hall tickets by following these steps: 
 Go to the official CAT website, iimcat.ac.in. 
 Look for the CAT Admit Card 2026 link on the homepage and click on it. 
 Enter your login details on the new page. 
 Click on the submit button. 
 Your admit card will appear on the screen. 
 Check all the details carefully and download the hall ticket. 
 Take a printout and keep it safe for the examination day. 
 CAT 2026 scorecards will be available on the official website. Candidates may also receive an SMS informing them about their results. The results are expected to be announced by the first week of January 2027. 
 The CAT 2026 score will remain valid until December 31, 2027. Candidates will be able to access their scorecards on the official website during this period. 
 CAT 2026: Admission process 
 Each IIM has its own admission rules and selection process. This includes different academic requirements, minimum marks and weightage for various factors. 
 A candidate's CAT 2026 performance will be an important part of the admission process. However, IIMs may also consider Class 10 and 12 marks, graduation scores, work experience and other factors while selecting candidates for the next stages. 
 Candidates should visit the official websites of individual IIMs to understand their admission rules and selection requirements.
